## Ebrahim Kargar

I love building for Builders. In my Product Management career, I've crafted platform products that drive growth — building from the ground up and scaling existing ones across food, mobility, and e-commerce. My expertise spans AI/ML and developer platforms, including APIs and authentication.

Known for staying hands-on and close to execution, inspiring cross-functional teams toward a bold shared vision, and championing ideas that are visionary and sometimes unconventional.

Currently **Product Lead, AI Platform** at [Smartly](https://www.smartly.io). Co-founder at [MimixLabs](https://mimixlabs.ai).
